description: Seasonal Climate Forecast Serves as a Call to Action is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Lane County, Oregon | Emergency Management. Faced with an increased chance for heavy precipitation and flooding, an emergency manager in Oregon spread the word, encouraging groups to be prepared. Coverage: Oregon (2015). The toolkit gives Oregon as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.

outcomes: Lane County, Oregon, extends from the Cascade Mountains to the Pacific Ocean. Its green forests reap the benefits of ample rainfall, but each year the region has to confront the possibility of high runoff and floods from wintertime precipitation and spring snowpack melt.
